title: evoproto v0.1.0: reference implementation of an evolution-informed, evidence-gated engineering design framework
description:
Reference implementation accompanying the article From Evolutionary Biology Data to Technological Prototypes: An AI-Driven Engineering Design Framework with an Evidence-Gated Validation Protocol.

The package implements the evolutionary-engineering knowledge graph (six node types, nine typed edges, homology and convergence mutually exclusive), Blomberg's K, Pagel's lambda and Stayton's C1 with a Brownian null, the analog retrieval score with a transfer-uncertainty measure, a constrained NSGA-II-style search with Deb's constraint domination and exact two-objective hypervolume, the evidence-gated decision rule with an abstention branch, and the three-arm pre-registered protocol with Wilcoxon / Holm / Cliff's delta / bootstrap analysis. It also regenerates every figure of the article from code.

The bundled pipeline runs in SYNTHETIC mode only: no biological records are redistributed. All numbers produced by the archive are tagged SYNTHETIC or MODELED and support no empirical claim.
